review: Independent test-oracle delta review for provider error classification
scope: Read-only review of the exact v4 delta from the previously approved v3 contract. No product, test, migration, dependency, database, or service changes; no test execution.

delta_review.assessment: The revised mapping is precise and independently testable from the local synthetic provider. Only token-endpoint HTTP 400/401 carrying invalid_grant maps to 401 AUTH_REQUIRED. invalid_request and other provider OAuth errors map to 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE even at 400/401; HTTP 200 with an OAuth error payload and HTTP 500 carrying invalid_grant also map to 503. Invalid signed-token claims remain 401. A compact literal status/error matrix distinguishes each branch and checks that no user/session is created on rejection.

carry_forward_review.v3_auth_retention_policy: Approved by this reviewer in g3-tc-contract-review-v3.json, SHA 768ff7818a700d01ab8a9c2edcae5a9ccbaaa34d169621b1fae9ca0955a2f85b. The v4 document carries the same explicit 002 migration, precise DELETE grants, bounded cleanup, admission limit, periodic scheduler and failure behavior.
carry_forward_review.testability: The existing isolated PostgreSQL fixture and test seams support real database migration, grant, expiry-boundary, 1000-row batching, 1024-row admission/race, scheduler retry, and shutdown cases. The parent separately specified the direct maintenance-call result shape for deterministic tests; observable row counts remain the independent behavioral oracle.

conditions: Preserve the approved v3 test review as historical evidence; v4 is the current exact contract pin.
Retain 001_initial.sql bytes and all 001 behavioral/hash assertions while updating migration inventory and drift fixtures for 002.
Use a literal matrix for token HTTP status and OAuth error body; do not infer statuses from product output.
Run no code/tests until both v4 reviews are recorded and the parent confirms the fixed candidate is ready; retain command stdout/stderr privately from the first run.
limitations: This approves the v4 contract for implementation and test authoring only, not the implementation, migration, G3, or B02 acceptance.
Synthetic loopback OIDC does not establish real corporate SSO, deployment TLS/proxy behavior, or original AT-21 completion.
The approved best-effort cleanup policy permits expired rows to remain during service/database outage; no immediate erasure guarantee is made.
